correctness.rationale: The 32-element geometric group and split order-eight translation lift are explicit published inputs. Exact F4 group-law computation shows Frobenius on E[8] acts by 5, while direct substitution f(x,y+x)=f+1 shows Frobenius exchanges the two lifts of [-1]. Thus Frobenius fixes precisely <t^2,u> and squares to identity on the full group. The standalone group/elliptic verifier passed.
